{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]

# Compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel"}
